svg.title: The schedule mode at two values of t
svg.desc: Two real renders of the gimbal demo's schedule mode, one at t = 0.229 where the two interpolations are furthest apart and one at t = 0.5 where they coincide exactly.
svg.text: the same mode at two values of t, from a real render
outward ticks slerp, inward ticks nlerp, magenta the long way round
4.5140° apart — the worst this arc gets
a test sampling t = 0, 0.5 and 1 certifies nlerp AS slerp — those are the three values where it is one
